l1_connect_account.title: Bring every region under the provider's plane
l1_connect_account.why: Regions run on their own cannot share tenants, quotas or metering, and each needs its own staff.
steps: List the regions and clusters that host tenants.
Register each region with the provider's management plane.
Confirm each region reports its tenants, quotas and usage centrally.
l1_connect_account.success: Every region in scope reports its tenants and usage to one plane.
